name: ThorneVet B ComplexVET soft chew (2 g)
note: Label per 2 g chew: thiamin 110 mg, riboflavin 18.2 mg, niacinamide 130 mg + niacin 10 mg, pantothenic acid (as calcium pantothenate) 120 mg, B6 (as P5P) 10 mg, folate (L-5-MTHF) 400 µg, B12 (methylcobalamin) 400 µg, biotin 400 µg, choline citrate 80 mg (= ~28 mg choline). Label dose for dogs: 1 chew per 25 lb (11 kg) daily, so about half a chew (1 g) for a 6 kg dog. Energy/macros estimated from the chew base (chickpea flour, tapioca, coconut/sunflower oil); calcium ~10 mg/chew from the calcium pantothenate. Source: label via drugs.com.
